objects.name: Hq_post
objects.prompt: a flat-roofed mud brick command post with a heavy steel door, a shaded porch along the front with a map board pinned under it, a short whip antenna stub on the roof and a stencilled unit plate beside the door

objects.name: Wet_canteen
objects.prompt: a mud brick canteen hall with a patched canvas roof, strings of small lanterns under the eaves, a wooden bench and table beside the open door, crates of bottles stacked against the wall

objects.name: Armory_magazine
objects.prompt: a windowless mud brick armory magazine with buttressed corners, one heavy steel double door with a crossbar and padlock, stencilled ammunition markings and a lightning spike on the roof

breeze.description: dust wisps off the roof edge

objects.name: Lockup
objects.prompt: a low mud brick detention blockhouse with narrow barred window slits, a single steel door with a sliding view hatch, and a lamp bracket over the door (bare roof state - the generator grew a scarecrow on the first take and the review missed it at thumbnail size)

breeze.description: the door lamp swings on its bracket

objects.name: Surgeon_tent
objects.prompt: an olive drab military medical tent on a welded steel frame with a red cross on a white plate over the entrance flap, a folding cot visible through the open front, sandbags stacked along one wall

objects.name: Water_truck
objects.prompt: a parked six-wheel military water tanker truck, olive drab cab dusted tan, riveted steel water tank with a rear tap manifold and a bucket hanging from it, intact and in service, not a wreck
